name: The St. Regis Cairo
insider_take: Where pharaonic grandeur meets legendary St. Regis service in the heart of ancient Cairo.
whats_special: The St. Regis Cairo stands as the only luxury hotel on the prestigious Nile Corniche with unobstructed river views. This architectural marvel features Egypt's first St. Regis Butler Service and houses the largest presidential suite in Africa at 6,500 square feet. The hotel's design incorporates authentic Egyptian motifs with Italian marble and crystal chandeliers, while its location places you just minutes from the Great Pyramids of Giza.
pro_tip: Book a Nile-facing room on floors 15+ for breathtaking sunrise views over the river, and time your stay during the monthly full moon for magical nighttime pyramid viewing from the hotel's terrace.
dont_miss: The signature afternoon tea service featuring Egyptian-inspired delicacies, a sunset felucca ride departing directly from the hotel's private dock, and the legendary St. Regis Bloody Mary ritual at La Zisa bar. The hotel's proximity to Khan el-Khalili bazaar (10 minutes) makes it perfect for authentic souvenir hunting between luxury amenities.
pros: Prime location on the Nile Corniche with stunning river views
Legendary St. Regis Butler Service for personalized luxury
Elegant European-inspired design with modern Egyptian touches
World-class dining venues including rooftop terrace restaurant
cons: Located in busy downtown area with urban traffic
